capabilities: Style list-type property values as colored pills with configurable shapes
Assign icons from over 1700 built-in icons, custom SVGs, emojis, or images
Attach custom links to styled values with locally cached favicons
Adapt pill colors automatically to light and dark mode
Generate local diagnostic reports for troubleshooting
extras: Only styles properties of type list. Known layout inconsistencies with the Minimal theme. Full feature guides are on an external documentation site. Author discloses the plugin was built with AI assistance (Antigravity) plus manual review.
intentEvidence: What was once limited to tags can now be customized for any Obsidian property.
motivation: The author wanted more customization options for properties, similar to Notion, but implemented the Obsidian way.
problem: Obsidian properties display as plain text, and rich visual styling like colored tags was previously limited to tags only.

relations.evidence: born from my desire to have more customization options for properties, similar to Notion

summary: Property styling plugin that renders metadata values as color-coded pills with icons in notes, Bases tables, and cards.
